column1: # unisacc kernel assembly byte oracle, x86-64 (spec §4.8 AS-4, AS-7). Hand-derived from the
# Intel 64 and IA-32 Architectures Software Developer's Manual (SDM) Vol. 2 and the AS rules; never
# copied from product output. Columns: id group form text section offset hex size relocs cite.
# text: assembly lines joined by " | "; the single line under test starts with "> ". The test
# assembles the whole text with `unisacc as -b lnx/x86_64` and compares hex at section+offset,
# the exact section size, and the exact .rela.text list ("-" = none; OFF:TYPE:SYM:ADDEND, SYM is
# .text/.data/.bss for a section symbol). form rel8/rel32 names the branch form (AS-4.8).
# Encoding notation in cites: REX=0100WRXB, ModRM=mod|reg|rm, SIB=scale|index|base (SDM 2.1-2.2).

column10: SDM ADD REX.W 03 /r (RM); base r12 needs SIB 0x24 (SDM 2.2.1.2)
SDM CALL E8 cd; AS-7 R_X86_64_PLT32 addend -4
SDM CALL E8 cd; rel32 = 0-6 resolved in-section (AS-7)
SDM CALL FF /2; ModRM 00|010|101 RIP+disp32; AS-7 PC32 .data addend 0-4
SDM CMP 83 /7 ib; rsp base SIB 0x24
SDM CMP 81 /7 id; dword admits full 32-bit pattern (AS-4.4)
SDM Jcc 0F 83 cd; AS-4.8 relaxation, rel32 = 198-6
SDM JMP E9 cd; AS-7 PLT32 tail transfer addend -4
SDM LEA; base rbp with no disp needs mod 01 disp8 0 (SDM Table 2-3 note)
SDM LEA REX.WRB; base r13 mod 01 disp8 0; SIB 10|010|101
SDM LEA; no base: SIB base 101 with mod 00 disp32 (SDM Table 2-3)
SDM LEA; no base disp32 (index-only SIB)
SDM LEA RIP-relative ModRM 00|001|101; AS-7 PC32 .data addend 8-4
SDM LEA RIP-relative; same-section disp32 = 0-8 resolved (AS-7)
AS-3 .long same-section label difference, 4 bytes little-endian
SDM MOV C6 /0 ib (AS-4: no B0+rb form)
SDM MOV 88 /r; sil requires a REX prefix (SDM 3.7.2.1)
SDM MOV C7 /0 id; mod 10 SIB 0x24
SDM MOV B8+rd id (small immediate still id)
SDM MOV REX.B 8B; r13 base mod 01 disp8 0
SDM MOV REX.W C7 /0 id; SIB 0x24
SDM MOV REX.W C7 /0 id (AS-4: movq imm is never B8+r)
SDM MOV; rbp base mod 01 disp8 0; SIB 11|011|101
SDM MOV; rbp base mod 01 disp8 0
SDM MOV REX.WB; r13 base mod 01 disp8 0
SDM MOV 89; rbp base mod 01 disp8 0
SDM MOVSXD REX.WB; r13 mod 01 disp8 0
SDM SHR C1 /5 ib (AS-4.5: an explicit count is never D1)
AS-3 .globl binding only; no bytes (binding checked in object.tsv)
AS-3 .p2align in data pads with zero bytes
AS-3 .p2align in x86 text pads with NOP 0x90 (SDM NOP 90)
AS-7 PLT32 addend = written addend - 4 (field-to-end distance)
AS-7 relocation records in instruction order
AS-7 PC32 against an undefined symbol
AS-7 PC32 addend counts the trailing imm32 (field end to instruction end = 8)
